articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.caption: Will Lankshear celebrates scoring the winning goal for Middlesbrough against Lincoln.

images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP

images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

keyEvents.text: Goal! Ipswich Town 0, Birmingham City 1. Carlos Vicente (Birmingham City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Demarai Gray (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Anis Mehmeti replaces Azor Matusiwa because of an injury.
Goal! Ipswich Town 1, Birmingham City 1. Ben Johnson (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Darnell Furlong with a cross.
Goal! Ipswich Town 2, Birmingham City 1. Kasey McAteer (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by George Hirst with a through ball.
First Half ends, Ipswich Town 2, Birmingham City 1.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Tomoki Iwata replaces Paik Seung-Ho.
Second Half begins Ipswich Town 2, Birmingham City 1.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Ethan Laird replaces Jonathan Panzo.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Ibrahim Osman replaces Demarai Gray.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jaden Philogene replaces Jack Clarke.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Chuba Akpom replaces George Hirst.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jack Taylor replaces Marcelino Núñez.
Jack Taylor (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Patrick Roberts replaces Carlos Vicente.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Marvin Ducksch replaces Jay Stansfield.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Cédric Kipré replaces Kasey McAteer.
